title: MemFit: Efficient Long-Term Agentic Memory
abstract: arXiv:2610.00872v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Long-term memory systems for large language models (LLMs) have gained popularity for extending reasoning capabilities across applications. Current memory systems rely on LLM agents to organize and consolidate memory, resulting in costly, inefficient write operations. To address this limitation, we propose MemFit, a long-term memory system for conversational agents that reduces the cost and latency of memory operations. Unlike existing systems that rely on expensive LLM calls for memory construction or discard surface-level details through compression, MemFit stores each turn verbatim in an append-only store with near-instantaneous, LLM-free insertion, indexing turns with segment summaries rather than replacing them. Additionally, MemFit uses an LLM-free, multi-path retrieval strategy that combines lexical and semantic signals with cross-encoder reranking over caption- augmented episodes in both textual and multimodal settings. translated_title: MemFit：高效的长程智能体记忆系统
translated_abstract: 面向大语言模型（LLM）的长期记忆系统因能够跨应用扩展推理能力而日益受到欢迎。现有记忆系统依赖 LLM 智能体来组织和整合记忆，导致写入操作成本高、效率低下。为解决这一局限，我们提出 MemFit，一个面向对话式智能体的长期记忆系统，能够显著降低记忆操作的成本与延迟。与依赖昂贵 LLM 调用来构建记忆、或通过压缩丢弃表层细节的现有系统不同，MemFit 将每一轮对话逐字存储在一个仅追加式存储中，实现近乎即时的无需 LLM 参与的插入，并通过分段摘要对轮次进行索引，而非替换它们。此外，MemFit 采用一种无需 LLM 的多路检索策略，将词汇信号与语义信号相结合，并在文本和多模态场景下对经过字幕增强的情节进行交叉编码器重排序。
tldr: MemFit 通过逐字追加式存储实现无 LLM 的即时写入，并采用结合词法与语义信号及交叉编码器重排序的无 LLM 多路检索策略，大幅降低了 LLM 长期记忆系统在写入和检索时的成本与延迟。
en_tdlr: MemFit is an efficient long-term memory system for conversational agents that stores every turn verbatim in an append-only store with near-instantaneous LLM-free insertion, and retrieves via an LLM-free multi-path strategy combining lexical and semantic signals with cross-encoder reranking, drastically reducing the cost and latency of memory operations.
